intro.p1: Users shall use the Service only after reading and agreeing to these Terms of Service.

article1.title: Article 1. Account
article1.p1: You shall manage your user ID, email address, and password at your own responsibility.
article1.p2: If you violate these Terms, the operator may delete your posts, suspend your use, or delete your account without notice.

article2.title: Article 2. Posts and Copyright
article2.p1: The copyright in an original work you post belongs to the person who created it.
article2.p2: You cannot post other people's works or derivative works based on them without the creator's permission. This also applies to works made with AI.
article2.p3: You shall hold the rights to the works you post or have permission from the rights holders. You shall resolve any rights problem at your own responsibility.
article2.p4: The operator automatically converts posted works with its system. You shall permit this. When you delete a post, the converted data is also deleted.

article3.title: Article 3. Posting Audio
article3.p1: Original songs may be posted after obtaining permission from all rights holders involved in the lyrics, composition, performance, and recording.
article3.p2: Covers of other people's songs may be posted only for songs whose creators freely allow covers. Songs managed by collecting societies cannot be posted at present.
article3.p3: Works that use other people's recordings, such as CD or streaming audio, cannot be posted. However, backing tracks that creators distribute for covers may be used.
article3.p4: Hi-res audio can be sold only for original works for which permission to sell has been obtained from all rights holders.

article4.title: Article 4. Prohibited Conduct
article4.p4: ・Posting works with violent or cruel depictions
article4.p7: ・Collecting content on the Service by scraping
article4.p8: ・Distributing, selling, or publishing purchased content outside the Service
article4.p9: ・Interfering with the operation of the Service

article5.title: Article 5. Advertising in Blogs
article5.p1: You may include advertising, such as affiliate links, in your blogs.
article5.p2: If your blog contains advertising, you shall turn on "Contains promotion" on the create or edit screen.

article6.title: Article 6. Paid Plans
article6.p1: Prices are shown on the plans page.
article6.p2: You pay on the day you subscribe, and the plan renews automatically every month.
article6.p3: You can cancel at any time. You can use the plan until the end of the paid period, and no prorated refund is given.
article6.p4: When you change plans, the new plan takes effect immediately. The difference is prorated and settled on your next bill.

article7.title: Article 7. Paid Content
article7.p1: Users on the Standard plan or higher who have registered an account to receive earnings can sell paid sections of blogs, comics, and hi-res audio.
article7.p2: At the time of payment, the sale price minus 15% is sent to the poster. The operator pays the payment processing fees.
article7.p3: Content that someone has bought cannot be deleted or taken off sale.
article7.p4: You shall use purchased content only for your personal enjoyment.
article7.p5: Refunds are not accepted after purchase. However, we will refund content that cannot be used because of a defect.
article7.p6: After a refund, the buyer can no longer use the content. The earnings sent to the poster are also reversed.

article8.title: Article 8. Disclaimer
article8.p1: The operator is not responsible for the content of posts.
article8.p2: The Service may be stopped without notice for maintenance, failures, and other reasons.

article9.title: Article 9. Changes and Governing Law
article9.p1: The operator may change these Terms. Changed Terms take effect when they are posted on this page.
article9.p2: These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Japan. The district court having jurisdiction over the operator's address shall have exclusive agreed jurisdiction as the court of first instance for any dispute concerning the Service.

collect.title: Information We Collect
collect.p1: Account and profile: email address, user name, nickname, name, date of birth, gender, country/region, and phone number and address (if entered)
collect.p2: Usage records: actions such as views, likes, and follows, IP address, and cookies
collect.p3:
Payments: records of payments and earnings.
Credit card numbers are handled by Stripe, and the operator does not receive them
collect.p4: Posts: content you post and its title, description, and so on

purpose.title: Purpose of Use
purpose.p1: To provide the Service, verify identity, and handle logins
purpose.p2: To process payments for paid plans and paid content, and to send earnings to posters
purpose.p4: To prevent misuse and improve the Service

thirdParty.title: Disclosure to Third Parties
thirdParty.p1: Except as required by law, we do not provide personal information to third parties without consent.
thirdParty.p2: Posts and profiles you make public can be seen by other users.

external.title: Use of External Services
external.p1: Stripe: payments and sending earnings to posters
external.p2: Amazon Web Services: storing and delivering data, and sending emails
external.p3: These companies are outside Japan (such as in the United States), and personal information may be handled abroad.
external.p4: Cookies are used to keep you logged in.

security.title: Security
security.p1: Communication is encrypted (HTTPS), and passwords are stored as hashes.
security.p2: Access to stored information is limited to what is necessary to run the Service.

request.title: Requests for Disclosure, Correction, or Deletion
request.p1: When you request disclosure, correction, deletion, or suspension of use of your personal information, we will respond without delay after confirming your identity.
request.p2:
You can withdraw from the settings page.
Requests to delete information after withdrawal are accepted at our contact address.
